name: Glossary demo CTA card
purpose: Convert glossary readers into demo or free-content visitors with a dark branded card closing the glossary page.
description: Oldest-system block (fixed 16px root) on /resources/lms-glossary: an 80rem container holding a #1b1b1b rounded (10px) card. Centred stack of the Nimbus wordmark, a 2.5rem (1.875rem <=767) H2, one line of white 1.25rem copy and two small green pill-less buttons side by side (stacked <=767), then a wide 1300:582 product image filling the card bottom. The card rises and fades in once when it enters the viewport.
